hero.summary: One object on the dark studio floor, a slow cinematic push-in and a rim light. Optional USB-C charger with charge running along the cable, heat glow and part labels.

params.object: laptop | battery | phone | chip | headphones | speaker | mic | card | panel | box | cylinder | sphere | solar | bulb
params.options: object options, e.g. {"screen": "battery", "level": 0.9} for laptop, {"on": 1} for bulb, {"cols": 6, "rows": 4} for solar
params.charger: true to plug a glowing USB-C cable into it
params.heat: 0 to 1, the object glows hot over the scene (battery)
params.push: how far the camera pushes in (default 0.22)

stack.summary: A cross-section of labelled layers that separate a little, with leader lines. A finger or stylus can touch the top and send a glow down to one layer. A layer can grow or hold trapped particles. Rain sends particles down into a layer, and release frees particles that run out along it.

params.layers: 2 to 5, top first: [{"label": "GLASS", "look": "glass|metal|grid|crust|solid|porous|film|layers|dots", "color": "#hex", "on": "word", "glow": true, "grow": true, "particles": true}]
params.touchOn: the word when the prop touches

flow.summary: Glowing particles travel between two or three labelled parts: electrons, ions, data, heat, water.

params.direction: forth | back | both (both turns round on reverseOn or halfway)
params.reverseOn: the word where the flow turns round
params.separator: true for a thin membrane between two parts

tokens.summary: A line of text as glowing chips. split: a sentence breaks into tokens, each in its own colour. append: new tokens drop onto the end of the line one after another, with a caret.

params.sentence: the text, split on spaces; "|" inside a word splits word pieces, e.g. "un|believ|able"
params.tokens: or the tokens as a list, instead of sentence
params.splitOn: the word the sentence splits on
params.next: append: the tokens that drop on, e.g. ["blue", "?"]
params.stampOn, stamp2On: append: the words each new token lands on

network.summary: A layered model of glowing nodes and connections. forward: signals sweep left to right, carrying input chips in and an output chip out. train: each round makes a guess that flashes red or green, then the error sweeps back and the weights shift.

params.stream: true to cycle the input chips in, like examples pouring in
params.output: a chip that comes out the far side
params.outcome: train: learn (red until the last round, then green) | wrong | right
params.meter: {"label": "Accuracy", "from": 0.3, "to": 0.9}: a bar always marked as an example
params.startOn: the word the first sweep starts on

rank.summary: A short ranked list as glowing 3D bars, top choice first, each with its word and value; the top bar lights up on its word.

params.example: true when the values are illustrative: the list is tagged "example"
params.growOn: the word the bars grow on
params.pickOn: the word the top bar lights up on
params.title: an optional label over the list

scan.summary: A face measured in 3D: infrared dots spray across it, the depth map lifts from flat into relief, a stored map slides in and matches, and a padlock opens.

params.dotsOn, depthOn, matchOn, unlockOn: the words each stage starts on
params.unlockText: the chip under the padlock (default "Unlocked"; "" for none)

fiber.summary: Light travelling down glass strands. overview: glowing strands carrying pulses. layers: one strand stripped back in steps, labelled. bounce: the strand cut open lengthways, a pulse zig-zagging down the core.

burst.summary: An object heats up and shatters into glowing shards with sparks and a shockwave. For failure, wear and destruction beats.

params.object: battery | phone | card | chip | panel | box
params.beatOn: the word it shatters on (default: about 55% through the scene)
params.heat: true to glow hot before it breaks (default true)

compare.summary: Two states side by side, such as before and after: two upright gauges that fill to their values, with a label and a value under each.

params.fillOn: the word when the right side drops to its value

wave.summary: Glowing waves: a signal, its mirror image, and their sum. For sound, radio, light, vibration and cancelling.

params.sumOn: the word when the waves meet

number.summary: One stat that lands: big chrome 3D digits slam in at their true value on the word (they never count up, so no wrong number is on screen), a glowing arc gauge, and a line under it.

params.label: the line under it, short
params.landOn: the word the number lands on
params.gauge: true to show the arc gauge for a percentage (default true for %)

title.summary: The end card: the topic in bold and a smaller italic line, over a dim turning object. Added automatically after the last scene when the script has none.

params.object: optional object under the title, as hero

custom.summary: Escape hatch: your own scene module, copied from explain-kit/scenes/custom-template.js.

params.module: path to the .js file, relative to the script folder
